prompt_recording.reason: The image tool returned images but did not export a durable exact raw-prompt receipt. These summaries preserve the executed creative intent without falsely claiming byte-exact prompts.

shared_direction.use_case: production small-business storefront and owned social campaign system
shared_direction.visual_language: hot-pink pop-up tent, lime skirting, transparent colorful drink pouches, crushed ice, condensation, citrus, deep plum shadows, playful premium editorial lighting
shared_direction.constraints: no people, no logos, no readable words, no prices, no contact data, no QR codes, no invented event facts, no watermarks
shared_direction.reference_rights: owner-supplied field photography used for the commissioned promotional build; raw photographs are not published

outputs.prompt_summary: Wide premium campaign scene with jewel-toned transparent drink pouches in crushed ice beneath a hot-pink market canopy, editorial lighting and negative space for native headline.
Square overhead flat lay of red, orange, lime, and berry drink pouches on ice with citrus and condensation, dense commercial composition for multiple component crops.
Extreme macro of neon lime, berry, and clear ice with water droplets and a pink straw, abstract high-detail brand texture.
Hot-pink beverage tent glowing at a polished outdoor night market, long line of colorful pouches, lime table skirt, atmospheric string lights and no people.

review.limitations: Outputs are illustrative campaign media and do not prove the real menu, stock, event setup, or customer experience.
